summary_1line: A courtesan seduces the naive ascetic Rishyasringa; he later describes the mysterious visitor to his father, unknowingly recounting the encounter with fascination and longing.

image_candidates.scene_text: The courtesan laughingly embraces the young ascetic in the forest hermitage while tossing a ball among flowering trees.
Rishyasringa sits alone in the forest after she leaves, sighing and staring upward in lovesick confusion.
The wild-haired sage Vibhandaka returns to the hermitage and finds his son seated sadly among ritual tools and firewood.
